name: Jek-14's stealth starfighter
description: Jek-14's stealth starfighter was a customized starship resembling the much later E-7 E-wing multi-role starfighter piloted by Jek-14 himself during the Clone Wars. The starfighter had earlier belonged to Count Dooku and General Grievous. Jek-14 then used it to escape from Count Dooku from Geonosis and also evade the forces of the Galactic Republic who also hunted him. The starfighter was first maintained by a yellow plated R-series astromech droid and then by R4-G0.
